articles.title: Ebola spreads in eastern DRC as Kenya confirms imported case

events.summary: Ebola cases are expanding in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, while Kenya has confirmed a fatal imported case. The developments highlight mounting difficulties in curbing the outbreak across borders.
events.why: Cross-border transmission of a high-fatality pathogen presents severe risks of a widening regional public health crisis.

articles.title: US bombs cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman ‘trying to run Iran blockade’
US forces disable ship ‘attempting to run’ Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman

events.summary: A US fighter jet bombed a commercial cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman, according to CENTCOM. The vessel was reportedly attempting to run an Iran blockade.
events.why: Direct US military strikes on commercial vessels in critical shipping lanes risk major geopolitical escalation and maritime trade disruptions.

articles.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ​province

events.summary: Pakistan imposed emergency rule in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. This action suspends the provincial government led by the political party of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan.
events.why: Suspending an elected provincial administration escalates political instability and central-provincial tensions across Pakistan.

articles.title: Taiz hospitals near collapse as Houthis tighten siege: Yemen government

events.summary: Hospitals in Taiz are on the verge of collapse as Houthi forces tighten their siege on the city. Medical services risk completely halting due to critically low reserves of fuel, medicine, and essential supplies.
events.why: A medical blockade in a major population center directly threatens civilian survival and violates humanitarian protections.

articles.title: Musk vows ‘affordable’ Starlink in India as he escalates feud with Ambani

events.summary: Elon Musk promised affordable Starlink services in India amid an escalating dispute with Mukesh Ambani. The commitment comes shortly before Reliance Jio's parent company conducts India's largest-ever IPO.
events.why: Competition between Starlink and Reliance Jio could reshape internet infrastructure pricing and access for hundreds of millions of consumers.

articles.title: Why have hundreds of 'cockroach' protesters been detained in Delhi

events.summary: Thousands of security personnel deployed in Delhi ahead of a Gen-Z led protest by the Cockroach Janta Party. Hundreds of protesters calling for electoral reforms were subsequently detained.
events.why: Mass detentions in a capital city signify growing civil tension and state crackdowns on youth-led electoral reform movements.
